_published_faq.name: How do I add Fospha  (EMEA & APAC) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fospha  (EMEA & APAC) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector.
